title: arXMCP bridge artifact envelope v1
description: Common envelope carried by EVERY bridge artifact exchanged between arXMCP and its consumers (downstream consumer pipelines, proving/exploration agents). The substrate block is the anti-stale-substrate device: given only an artifact file, a checker can decide whether the current server substrate matches the one the artifact was produced against (the spike-1/2/3 failure class). Versioning is per-artifact-type MAJOR.MINOR: MINOR bumps are additive-only and consumers MUST ignore unknown fields (this schema therefore does NOT set additionalProperties:false anywhere); MAJOR bumps are breaking and consumers MUST refuse an unknown MAJOR with a precise diagnostic. Enums are append-only within a MAJOR. See contracts/CONTRACTS.md for the changelog and full rules.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of THAT artifact type (per-type, not repo-global).

producer.description: Producing component, e.g. proof-verify-arxmcp-querier, arxmcp-server, exploration-scout.

produced_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. The pattern is enforced (jsonschema format checking is annotation-only by default).

substrate.description: The substrate pin. notebook/corpus_version/filter_echo are null ONLY for server-scoped artifacts (e.g. corpus-snapshot); notebook-scoped artifact types tighten these to non-null in their own schemas.

server.description: Producing substrate server. Append-only enum within this MAJOR.

corpus_version.description: The per-notebook LanceDB corpus-version marker value at production time; null only for server-scoped artifacts.

notebook.description: Notebook scope (slug + arxmcp:// URI), or null for server-scoped artifacts.

filter_echo.description: The notebook filter the server AFFIRMED it honored (requires the filter-echo server fix, WS-A). Null when no notebook filter was in play.

retrieval_mode.description: D8 pin: dense_only is the sole live retrieval mode (hybrid modules exist but are unwired behind a CLOSED-NO verdict, finding 211 R-B). Any change to this enum is a versioned, deliberately-batched event recorded in CONTRACTS.md, never a side effect.

tool_schema_sha256.description: EXPECTED_TOOL_SCHEMA_SHA256 (the BP1 tools/list byte-stability pin) at call time.

payload.description: Artifact-type-specific payload; per-domain verdict vocabularies allowed (vocabularies do NOT unify across pipelines - SP2 evidence).

artifact_ref.description: A reference to another bridge artifact (used by run-ledger-entry and future composers).
